observations: A vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden table with metal legs and a foot pedal.
The machine has a black body with gold decorative patterns and text in Chinese and English.
The table has a drawer with a circular cutout and two side drawers with knobs.
The machine is mounted on a metal stand with a foot pedal and a metal plate at the base.
The table surface shows some wear and scratches, especially on the right side.
The machine appears to be a manual sewing machine with a handwheel, not an automatic one.
No motor is visible in any photo; the claim of an automatic motor is not supported by visual evidence.
